_doc: Swimming on the inner map (world/innerMap/swimming.js: where; player/swimming.js: what it does). A stroke is one tile of water the player can't stand in. pathCost: how much dearer a water tile is than a step when choosing a route (so a walk round wins when not much longer); speed: a stroke's pace against a step; the Swimming skill (systems/practiceSkills.js, data/practiceSkills.json: XP each stroke, levels) cuts the energy a stroke costs and quickens it. A swim washes you up to hygieneMax and soaks the clothes (comfort). Cold water (cold.seasons, or a cold hex) hurts each stroke. Below tiredBelow energy you struggle (struggleHealth a stroke), below spentBelow you go under (drownHealth). Too laden (pack fuller than ladenShare) or too spent, you can't take to the water.
